question: A woman travels 282 km at a speed of 47 km/hr, the next 120 km at a speed of 20 km/hr and the next 496 km at a speed of 62 km/hr. What is her average speed (in km/hr) during the entire journey?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Total Distance = 282 + 120 + 496 = 898 km

Total Time = (282 ÷ 47) + (120 ÷ 20) + (496 ÷ 62) = 6 + 6 + 8 = 20 hr

Average Speed = 898 ÷ 20 = 44.9 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 44.9 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance 1 (D₁) = 282 km, Speed 1 (S₁) = 47 km/hr

Distance 2 (D₂) = 120 km, Speed 2 (S₂) = 20 km/hr

Distance 3 (D₃) = 496 km, Speed 3 (S₃) = 62 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time
